EXACT WEIGHTED-PATH COMPILER CERTIFICATE
================================================================================================

Each row certifies B <= left and x_* <= left, hence [0,left] -> [0,target].
gamma=1-1/s (s=infinity means gamma=1); H is a spanning disjoint union
of c nontrivial paths on m vertices; rho=(gamma*m-e(H))/(gamma*m);
T=gamma/(2m), B=T*4(1-rho)/(2-rho)^2, x_*=4rho*T.

Special reciprocal bridges:
left | target | m | s | c | rho | B | x_*

1/108 | 1/106 | 53 | infinity | 13 | 13/53 | 80/8649 | 26/2809
